summary:
Verified LOGO FIX and DOCS CENTER work (both backend + frontend) against live preview https://aegis-rmf-demo.preview.emergentagent.com. Did NOT re-run full backend pytest/acceptance suites per main-agent instruction (they reset the test DB). Instead added focused /app/backend/tests/test_docs_center_security.py (15 tests, 15/15 PASS, 11.47s). UI verified on live preview as isso@aegisrmf.demo. LOGO FIX (acceptance criteria from request): PASS. * Login page light theme: brand-lockup /controls page). * Favicon: GET /favicon.svg -> 200, GET /favicon.ico -> 200 (both served). * Theme toggle present on login (data-testid="theme-toggle-btn") and in header; toggling flips html.dark and swaps the lockup to the dark variant on reload. DOCS CENTER (acceptance criteria from request): PASS. Backend (pytest, 15/15): * Unauth GET /api/v1/docs-center, /docs-center/digitalocean, /docs-center/digitalocean/download, /docs-center/archive.zip all return 401. * Authed GET /api/v1/docs-center returns 200 with items incl. slugs 'digitalocean' and 'readme'; every item has non-empty title. * Authed GET /api/v1/docs-center/digitalocean returns 200 with markdown containing 'documentation only' and >=13 numbered '## N' H2 sections (asserted 13). * Authed GET /api/v1/docs-center/digitalocean/download returns 200 text/markdown with Content-Disposition attachment. * Authed GET /api/v1/docs-center/archive.zip returns 200 application/zip starting with PK magic, >1KB. * Traversal / unknown slugs: etc-passwd, unknown-slug, ..%2F..%2Fbackend%2F.env, ../../backend/.env, ....//....//etc/passwd, readme%00.md ALL return 404 and never leak jwt_secret / mongo_url / 'root:x:' / env contents. Same for /{bad_slug}/download. Frontend (Playwright live preview): * header-docs-link (book icon) in header navigates to /docs-center. * admin-docs-link data-testid present on /admin. * /docs-center lists all 12 docs incl. 'DigitalOcean deployment guide', shows 'Download all docs (.zip)' button. * /docs-center/digitalocean renders with the yellow 'Status: documentation only – not yet executed on DigitalOcean' callout and exactly 13

sections (document.querySelectorAll('h2').length === 13). * Renders cleanly in both light and dark themes (verified via theme-toggle round-trip, no layout break). SMOKE REGRESSION: PASS. * POA&M page loads after login (text 'POA' present). Sidebar highlights 'Admin' when on /admin and 'Controls' when on system control page (observed in screenshot — Admin pill highlighted on /admin render). * Demo data looks normal (no 5k perf findings bloat seen; controls page loads quickly). * Phase 5 banner 'Phase 5 · Production Hardening · Synthetic tenant only' present at sidebar bottom. LTP system id this run (post-reset): 3b9039dd-dd64-41bc-a773-1730c433358e (matches test_credentials.md note).

issues: Benign CSP console errors persist from Emergent platform injection: Cloudflare Insights beacon.min.js blocked by script-src, blob-worker (session replay) blocked because worker-src not set. Platform-level, not application code. Unchanged from iteration_7 observation.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/app/api/v1/docs_center.py: solid allowlist pattern — a fixed DOCS dict maps slug->(relative_path, title), FastAPI path parameter is used as a dict key only (never joined to a user string), and even if a traversal character made it to the key it would fail the dict lookup -> 404. Additionally _file() resolves and checks `root not in p.parents or not p.is_file()` as a belt-and-braces check in case DOCS is edited unsafely later. Good defense-in-depth.
docs_center router correctly requires get_current_user on every route INCLUDING /archive.zip, confirmed 401 without bearer. No endpoint leaks file contents on 404 (FastAPI default error body).

LoginPage uses responsive PNG srcset (288/576) + separate -dark variant swapped via theme context — correct approach for the 'crisp 1x/2x and readable in dark mode' acceptance criterion. The dark PNG is a true dark-themed artwork (not CSS filter), which keeps alpha/edges clean.

Header brand-logo uses srcset with 1x/2x/4x (40/80/160) — slight overkill for a 40px slot but harmless; webpack is base64-inlining the 1x variant (<~8KB) which is why currentSrc shows a data: URI — that is a performance optimization, not a bug.

Static docs are read from disk per-request (p.read_text / p.read_bytes) with no caching. For 12 small Markdown files this is fine; if the archive gets large or hot in CI, consider mtime-based memoization. Not blocking.
test_docs_center_security.py exercises traversal, null-byte, and double-dot-slash variants and all are rejected — recommend keeping this file in regression.

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 docs-center security tests; full suite not re-run per instructions — main agent reported 91/91 + 12/12 acceptance earlier)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of logo + Docs Center acceptance criteria verified live

test_credentials: Used isso@aegisrmf.demo / AegisDemo!2026 from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. One login consumed; rate limit (20/60s/IP) nowhere near reached.
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only: list/get/download docs + one authenticated SPA session + one archive.zip fetch. No DB mutations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: LOGO + Docs Center acceptance verified against live preview on 2026-01-12. New regression file /app/backend/tests/test_docs_center_security.py (15 tests, module scope auth fixture) — safe to keep in CI; it only reads docs and does not touch DB. LTP system id after current reset = 3b9039dd-dd64-41bc-a773-1730c433358e. Do NOT run `pytest tests/acceptance` concurrently with other backend tests (resets the DB per earlier notes). CSP console errors from Cloudflare beacon + blob worker are Emergent-ingress-injected and benign; ignore. All 12 doc slugs in backend DOCS dict are present on disk (list_docs returned 12 items with available=true implied by UI rendering).
rca of the issue: No defects found. All requested acceptance criteria met: (1) Logo-01.webp-equivalent official shield/vortex/keyhole lockup is now served as responsive PNG srcset on both login (288/576, dark variant) and header (40/80/160, data-testid brand-logo/brand-lockup) in both themes — the previous hand-drawn SVG is gone; favicon.svg + favicon.ico both return 200; theme toggle persists. (2) Demo data normal, no 5k perf findings. (3) Docs Center is production-grade: auth-gated allowlist with no path-traversal surface, per-doc .md download, archive.zip of all docs, DigitalOcean guide rendered with 13 numbered sections and the 'documentation only' callout, header book icon + admin page link both navigate correctly. (4) scripts/verify_no_preview_deps.sh PASS was reported by main agent earlier. (5) Regression smoke (POA&M, Controls, sidebar highlight) passes. 15/15 new docs-center security tests pass.
